Great bar but average restaurant
Dec 2025 • Friends
We visited Skylight Rooftop Beach Club for drinks and really enjoyed the experience. The views over the city and coastline are excellent, especially in the evening. The atmosphere is lively but still comfortable, with good music and a well-designed rooftop setting. Cocktails were well made, service was efficient, and overall it’s a very good spot for sunset or a night drink with a view.

We also had a meal at La Kitchen in Nha Trang and were not particularly impressed. The restaurant has a modern, clean look, but the food itself was very average and lacked any standout flavours or presentation. Service was polite but not very attentive, which further affected the experience. Overall, it works if you need a convenient place to eat, but it didn’t leave a strong impression and we wouldn’t go out of our way to return.

Overly Priced Viewpoint
Apr 2025 • Friends
Overly priced viewpoint. Great location and view, no doubt, but plan to open that wallet for extremely overpriced drinks and sub-par food. In the event you order food after you have been scalped before going up, check your bill to make sure they are charging the correct prices. The servers stand around the bar chatting so when you need something you almost have to get up and get it yourself. For what you are paying, this should be nearly white glove experience. When I received my bill, it was indeed way over what it should have been and getting it corrected led to a very uncomfortable conversation. I wouldn't recommend it in all honesty, but if you're feeling froggy...JUMP!!
